title: Private VPC: Offline lifecycle, simulated partition tests, and operator quarantine acceptance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: define concrete requirements and acceptance criteria for performing operator-driven upgrades, offline artifact syncs, and simulated network partitions in Private/VPC deployments. Scope includes: operator quarantine behavior during partial connectivity, deterministic artifact verification without egress, staged canary plans across islanded sites, and test harnesses for simulated partition scenarios. Non-goal: changing operator runtime architecture or adding new encryption primitives; those are separate infra/refactor initiatives.
requirements: Minimal egress: system must be able to validate image/artifact provenance and proceed with an upgrade using only pre-staged artifacts and signed manifests when egress is unavailable.
Operator quarantine mode: operator must support a quarantine state where control-plane activities that require external verification are paused while local preconditions and signatures are validated.
Deterministic artifact validation: support offline signature verification (PSA/HSM or container image signatures) with configurable trust store and clear failure modes for mismatches.

Staged canary across partitions: provide a declarative canary plan that can target subsets of nodes/namespaces and can be executed under partial isolation (e.g., one site has egress, another doesn't).

Telemetry under airgap: collect local telemetry during offline upgrades and provide a secure, redacted telemetry bundle that can be exported by operators for post-upgrade analysis without leaking sensitive customer data.

Rollback triggers: define local and global rollback triggers (e.g., control-plane crashloop, >5% qps failure, model-serving latency regression >2x baseline) that can be evaluated when central control is unreachable.
Simulation harness: include an automated test harness (k8s chaos jobs or operator-level simulator) that can reproducibly simulate network partitions and validate behavior against acceptance criteria.
Operator compatibility: ensure operator upgrade code paths are backward compatible for previous 2 minor releases when running in offline/quarantine mode to avoid operator-brick scenarios.
Runbook and operator UX: provide clear operator-facing progress states, human-confirmation gates, and suggested commands for emergency rollback and artifact injection.

Compliance checks: if customer configuration requires zero-egress mode, upgrades must be possible via signed bundles delivered over approved channels (air-gapped media or vendor-approved mirror) and documented in the PRD.
non_goals: Implementing new cryptographic signing algorithms (out of scope).
Replacing customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations—assume existing integrations remain.
Engineering an entirely new multi-site replication layer—leverage mirrors and mirrors-scheduling already in other projects.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Offline upgrade with no outbound egress succeeds end-to-end using a signed bundle: operator transitions from 'canary' -> 'apply' -> 'complete' without external API calls. Verification: runbook steps and CI job demonstrating deterministic success on a 3-node islanded cluster.

AC-2: Operator quarantine state is reachable and exits only after explicit operator confirmation or successful local validation. Verification: unit tests + e2e demonstrating blocked risky operations when in quarantine and a documented operator-approved override flow.

AC-3: Simulated partition harness reproduces at least three fault modes (leader partition, partial egress loss, control-plane network flaps) and tests produce deterministic pass/fail for rollback triggers. Verification: harness artifacts (logs, traces) uploaded to internal Drive link and CI pass/fail artifacts included in PR.

AC-4: Telemetry bundle during offline upgrade contains required metrics (upgrade duration, per-pod restart counts, serving latency percentiles) and excludes customer-sensitive payloads per the telemetry redaction guideline. Verification: sample bundle inspected and automated diff shows no secrets or PII fields.

AC-5: Canary plan supports asymmetric rollout (site-A with egress + site-B without), and automatic fallback to previous image is performed if post-canary health checks fail within the configured window (default 10 minutes). Verification: test scenario where canary fails on isolated site and traffic is routed back to stable variant with documented metrics showing restored health.

AC-6: Upgrade path is compatible with operator versions N and N-1 (two minor versions back). Verification: cross-version upgrade matrices and smoke tests under offline conditions included in the release checklist.
AC-7: Runbook is reviewed and signed off by Support and SRE with explicit steps for emergency rollback and artifact injection. Verification: sign-off comment and link to runbook in PRD.
test_plan: Create a CI job 'private-offline-upgrade' that runs against a 3-node kind/k3d cluster with egress disabled by iptables to emulate airgap; job exercises staged bundle install and verifies serving continuity.

Extend chaos tests: add 'partition-simulator' k8s job that introduces asymmetric network latencies and drops between control-plane and site nodes, validating rollback triggers and operator quarantine transitions.
Manual canary playbook: ops engineer executes a staged canary across two simulated sites (A/B) with one site behind a simulated mirror; collect telemetry bundle and validate redaction.
Compatibility matrix sweep: execute operator upgrade/downgrade scenarios across N-2..N versions in offline mode and report failures to the release board.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (internal): run harness in CI and collect artifacts. Target: all tests green in CI and SRE sign-off.
Stage 1 (pilot customers): enable in 3 existing private customers who have approved test windows and mirror-based artifact delivery. Provide 24/7 SRE on-call for first 72 hours.
Stage 2 (wider opt-in): open as opt-in flag for all Private deployments with documentation and runbook. Monitor canary health metrics for 14 days before defaulting to general availability.
Stage 3 (GA): flip default for scheduled upgrades and include in commercial upgrade contracts.
